parsed.summary: The alert shows a burst of 418 file renames to a new '.lablocked' suffix within 45 seconds on the host, which is consistent with mass encryption or file locking behavior. A recovery-copy deletion was also attempted, although it was blocked, so the impact is not fully confirmed beyond strong ransomware-like activity.
